test_title: PYST 11: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the statements and conclusions given below carefully. You have to believe that the given statements are true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the conclusions logically follows from the given statements.

**Statements:** Some erasers are paper. Some papers are clips. All clips are hair.

**conclusion:**

(I) All paper is hair.

(II) Some erasers are clips.

options.text: Only conclusion (II) follows from the statements.
Only conclusion (I) follows from the statements.
Neither conclusion (I) nor conclusion (II) follows from the statements.
Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow the statements.

solution:
Statements:

Some erasers are papers, Some papers are clips, and All clips are hair.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d77a5eb4b2acd40b91be57e35652649d865f4f584e4790e65c42d196abfc0b7b.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All papers are hair. → Not follow (Because some papers are clips and all clips are hair, which means some papers are hair is definitely true, whereas all papers are hair can be possible but not definitely true)

(II) Some erasers are clips. → Not follow (Because there is no direct relation between erasers and clips, so some erasers are clips can be possible but not definitely true)

Hence, the correct answer is "Neither (I) nor (II) follow".
